_comment: Curated waypoints. Coordinates are NOT typed in here: prepare_data.py resolves each entry from the NASA rover waypoint record with the given site/drive, so every location comes from a published localization. Science text is a short paraphrase of the cited sources; read the sources for authoritative wording.

habitat.name: Hypothetical habitat (placed at Octavia E. Butler landing localization)
habitat.note: No habitat exists on Mars. Placed at the rover's first localized position after landing (site 3, drive 0, sol 13) so the origin sits at a well-documented, flat crater-floor location.

sites.name: Wildcat Ridge (delta front)
sites.location_basis: Rover localization at site 26 / drive 1222 (sols 502 onward), the parking position during the Wildcat Ridge abrasion and coring campaign. The outcrop is within metres of the rover, not exactly at this point.
sites.science_summary: Layered, fine-grained sedimentary rock at the front of the Jezero delta, interpreted as mud and fine sand deposited in an evaporating lake. SHERLOC made the mission's most abundant organic-molecule detections to date on the Berry Hollow abrasion patch. Cores 'Hazeltop' (kept on the rover) and 'Bearwallow' (later placed in the Three Forks depot) were collected here.

citations.title: NASA's Perseverance Rover Investigates Geologically Rich Mars Terrain (NASA/JPL news release, 15 Sept 2022)
PIA24929: Perseverance Rock Cores From Wildcat Ridge (Hazeltop imaged sol 509)

sites.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
sites.location_basis: Rover localization at site 32 / drive 250 (sol 654), at the start of depot operations. The 10 tubes were dropped at mapped spots spread over the depot area between sols 653 and 690.
sites.science_summary: A flat area near the base of the Jezero delta where Perseverance laid down 10 duplicate sample tubes (rock cores, regolith, atmosphere and a witness tube) as a backup cache for Mars Sample Return. It is a reference point for a planned retrieval stop, not an outcrop.

citations.title: NASA's Perseverance Rover Deposits First Sample on Mars Surface (NASA/JPL news, Dec 2022)
PIA25682: Perseverance's Three Forks Sample Depot Map

geology_unit_notes.Njf: Jezero floor unit: crater-floor unit interpreted by the map authors to underlie the fan units; published age estimates range widely (see pamphlet).
geology_unit_notes.NHjf1: Jezero fan unit 1: topographically lower, older member of the Jezero fan (delta) deposits.
geology_unit_notes.NHjf2: Jezero fan unit 2: topographically higher, younger member of the Jezero fan (delta) deposits.
geology_unit_notes.Nle: Lower etched unit: olivine-rich unit found only inside Jezero crater, the stratigraphically lower complement of the upper etched unit.
geology_unit_notes.Nue: Upper etched unit: widely occurring olivine-rich unit with several surface textures.
geology_unit_notes.Aeb: Eolian bedform unit: young windblown bedforms (for example transverse aeolian ridges).
